title: Plaid developers
description: A deep indigo-navy panel with 40px corners and a soft periwinkle glow around it: a centred two-line 70px white headline, a short line, a cyan-to-periwinkle pill and a near-black rainbow-rimmed pill, then a near-black code window flush with the panel's bottom: an endpoint path over a hairline, numbered lines with function names in cyan and numbers in yellow, long lines cut with an ellipsis.
notes: the original's moving wave-line canvas behind the window is reduced to a soft periwinkle light at the bottom of the panel
the panel is the foreground colour in light mode, the card colour in dark mode; the code window is primary (background in dark mode)
